name.description: Concise flashcard set title, max 5 words

topic.description: 2-4 hyphenated lowercase nouns, general to specific (e.g., 'biology-cells-mitochondria')

desc.description: 30-50 word description summarizing the flashcard set content

front.description: The front side of the flashcard: a term, concept, question or prompt. Keep it short (max ~25 words). Use MathJax ($...$) for math expressions.

back.description: The back side of the flashcard: the definition, answer or explanation. Concise but complete (max ~40 words).
